If an event participant's Person is empty, discard the participant.
The GLX spec requires a person, but GLX validation allows empty.

-- test.glx --
persons:
    existing-person:
        properties: {}
events:
    event-with-error:
        type: birth
        participants:
        -   role: subject
            # No person
    event-well-formed:
        type: birth
        participants:
        -   role: subject
            person: existing-person
-- want-errors --
events\[event-with-error\].Participants\[0\]: discarding participant: person must not be empty
-- want-catalog.yaml --
events:
    event-with-error:
        type:
            definition:
                label: Birth
            value: birth
        properties: {}
        participants: [] # Ill-formed participant discarded
    event-well-formed:
        type:
            definition:
                label: Birth
            value: birth
        properties: {}
        participants:
        -   role:
                definition:
                    label: Subject
                value: subject
            person: persons/existing-person
persons:
    existing-person:
        properties: {}
